name: Anna Koishi
source:
Anna is a campaign manager and one of Your Character's love interests. She is first seen in Chapter 2.

Publicly, Anna appears polished, calm and polite, radiating strength and confidence. She is not unshakeable, however, as she is clearly frustrated and disappointed following a poor interview with Ellen Thompson. Additionally, it is revealed in a premium scene that similar to Your Character, she had considerable pressure from her father growing up to succeed. Despite this, she has dedicated much of her life to causes she finds worthy, even if they don't always pan out, and provides Your Character with advice throughout the story.

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Anna_Koishi]Wiki[/url]]
